records.title: Start Making Sense(s): A Developmental Probe of Attention Specialization Using Lexical Ambiguity
records.reason: This is an attention specialization/interpretability study, not attention-kernel or inference acceleration.

records.title: Learning Skill-Attributes for Transferable Assessment in Video
records.reason: The paper develops transferable video-based human skill assessment and addresses supervision scarcity; it does not improve LLM inference serving.

records.title: A Circular Argument : Does RoPE need to be Equivariant for Vision?
records.reason: The paper analyzes RoPE positional equivariance for vision models and provides no language inference optimization.

records.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals tryptophan metabolism restricting maturation of intratumoral tertiary lymphoid structures.
records.reason: The DOI publisher page could not be retrieved for primary-text verification. Packet abstract/title concern tumor spatial transcriptomics and tryptophan metabolism, apparently unrelated; linked lineage means retain as retrieval-blocked borderline.

records.title: Normalizing Flows are Capable Generative Models
records.reason: The full text studies normalizing flows as general continuous-input generative models, not language-model inference efficiency or sparse-attention runtime.
